text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964

Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: OPDS/LND/08/ACQ/01/01. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/5/2018/HA/80. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: Described following Lot of land containing in extent of about 0.9385 Hectare, Showing Lot No. 01 of Cadastral Map No. 620665 in Extra No. 01 and Sheet No. 01, Hunuwalawaththa in the Grama Niladhari Division of Hunuwala North in Helapalle Paththuwa in Meda Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Opanayaka of Ratnapura District in Sabaragamuwa Province. Schedule Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Hunuwalawaththa; Claimants of the Land: 01. Basnayaka Nilame, Sabaragamuwa Maha

Saman Devalaya, Rathnapura, 02. Superintendent, Kahawaththa Plantation, Hunuwala, 03. State Plantation Corporation, 11th Floor, Sethsiripaya Second Stage, Battaramulla, 04. Land Reforms Commission, Good Shed Road, New Town, Embilipitiya; Extent: 0.9385 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat of Openayaka on the 02nd day of June in 2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 26th day of May, in 2025, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. H. Dඁൺආආං඄ൺ Sൺඍඁൺඋൺඌංඇ඀ඁൺ, Divisional Secretary, Opanayaka. On 21st of January, 2025, At the Divisional Secretariat, Opanayaka. EOG 01- 0232
